core_obligations: Reduce a trivial divisor class to a section with zero divisor (proof lines 6880-6888).
Work locally on an affine normal domain (proof lines 6888-6895).
Use the DVR and intersection statements to conclude that t is a unit (proof lines 6895-6904).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a locally Noetherian integral normal scheme X the map Pic(X) -> Cl(X) is injective (source lines 6873-6878). The proof takes an invertible module whose associated divisor class is trivial, chooses a regular meromorphic section s, multiplies by the inverse of the rational function realising the divisor to get a section t with zero divisor, and then shows t trivialises L: locally on an affine X = Spec(A) with A a Noetherian normal domain, vanishing of ord at all height one primes forces t into A and t^{-1} into A by the intersection of the localisations at height one primes.
